title: WEXP × AEP: signed sandbox records under Core-02
summary: WEXP x AEP (Anton Sokolov): two aep-sandbox samples (signed record and mandate, no platform Evidence) mapped to Core-02 under two evaluation contexts; both appraisers agree; the execution claim stays not evaluated and the boundary unsupported, while the sandbox verifier checks authority and record authorship. Mapping checked by the AEP author against -06.

artifact.role: Public selection of the source material and observations of the 9 November trial. The file inventory distinguishes original bytes from public representations.

payload.mode_note: Remove the aep-applicability-001/ prefix from ZIP entries to obtain payload paths. All extracted file bytes match the public source archive.

independence.scope: The mapping and both implementations are from the same WEXP project. No independent reproduction is recorded. Mapping and appraisal: Mikhail Sergeev (WEXP). AEP draft and sandbox: Anton Sokolov (Tyche Institute). The AEP author reviewed the mapping against draft -06 and the pinned sandbox code and did not run the appraisers.
independence.method: Mikhail Sergeev initiated the trial and operated both appraisers. The WEXP side froze six normalized inputs and the expected components before its historical run on 9 November. Anton Sokolov reviewed the AEP reading after execution. The two WEXP implementations share an operator, and the second pin includes documented post-corpus fixes.

result.label: Two appraisers agree on 120/120 components; each matches frozen expectations on 114/120.
result.details: The comparison dimension refers only to ref versus check on the same six inputs. The native verdicts are ALLOW, DENY/replayed and DENY/scope_violation. All six Core assessments downgrade, with attributed grounding, an unsupported boundary and execution not evaluated. Six frozen boundary_ceiling strings differ from the null in each appraiser's output. A separate WEXP-operated execution of the prepared public package is recorded in evidence/public-run/RUN-RECORD.json.

limitations: Six named assessments are three cases under two contexts, using two signed sandbox samples and four distinct normalized byte streams.
Neither packet contains platform Evidence. The boundary result applies only to the two tested signed-record samples.
The sandbox verifier checked authority and record authorship; AEP-06 leaves the authorization decision to the relying party.
The record and native verifier supply no independent measurement that the reported action or its external effect occurred.
Separate AI-assisted sessions shared one operator and project. The mapping review covers the AEP interpretation only. No independent reproduction is recorded.
Only the publicly selected files can be verified here. The inventory distinguishes direct historical byte checks from the preparation and execution of the public selection.
